〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨若拿下國會 哪些美股最敏感？華爾街點名四大類股

美國期中選舉投票登場，部分民調與多數預測市場看好民主黨拿下參眾兩院，但華爾街的持股布局尚未充分反映這種結果。據《CNBC》報導，摩根大通估計，若民主黨全面掌控國會，標普500指數周三(4日)可能下跌約0.5%；若共和黨失去眾院、卻守住參院，指數反而有望上漲最多1%。對投資人而言，選舉結果不只牽動大盤，也可能改變AI、國防、醫療與金融股的走勢。全文詳讀

《路透》：美對陸半導體限制 SK海力士紐約州晶片廠卡關

AI會引爆下一場金融海嘯嗎？前紐約聯準銀行總裁點出關鍵差別

若目前規劃的AI基礎設施全數建成，總投資可能超過10兆美元。前紐約聯準銀行總裁杜德利(Bill Dudley)在《彭博》專欄指出，考量資料中心折舊速度，AI產業每年可能需要至少3兆美元營收，才能為這筆投資帶來足夠報酬。他認為，熱潮退去可能引發股市大幅修正，但要演變成另一場2008年規模的金融危機，機率仍低。更難判斷的是，一旦資料中心賺不到預期的錢，損失最後會落在誰身上。全文詳讀

items.title_en: Micron's December Share‑Buyback Lockup Ends; Barron's: FY2027 Potential Scale Could Reach $100 Billion
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，美光 (MU-US) 股票回購限制將於 12 月 9 日屆滿，可望為近期承壓的股價帶來支撐。若獲利與自由現金流符合預期，在截至 2027 年 8 月底的 2027 會計年度，公司潛在回購規模可能達到 1,000 億美元，相當於報導當時市值約一成。
這項潛在利多浮現之際，市場正重新評估記憶體漲價循環能延續多久。
日本 NAND 大廠鎧俠週一 (2 日) 公布審慎展望，拖累美光週一暴跌近 6%，週二隨著大盤回暖，收高2.58% 至每股 855.10 美元，今年迄今漲幅高達171.10%。
美光先前獲得約 60 億美元的美國晶片法案補助，用於支持包括紐約州在內的新記憶體廠建設，但補助條件嚴格限制股票回購，主要僅允許公司買回股票，以抵銷員工股權獎酬造成的股本稀釋。
因此，在截至 2026 年 8 月底的 2026 會計年度，美光僅回購約 6.5 億美元股票。
自今年 12 月 9 日起，美光接下來三年可執行的回購規模，將可大致與自由現金流相當，為擴大股東回饋打開空間。
公司已於 10 月 8 日將股票回購授權增加 330 億美元，使總額提高至 352 億美元，並表示長期目標是將百分之百的超額現金回饋股東。
不過，超額現金仍須考量營運、資金保留與其他用途，不能直接等同於全部自由現金流。
美光擴大回購的底氣，來自記憶體需求與價格上升帶動的獲利成長。
截至今年 8 月底的第四季，調整後每股盈餘達 33.42 美元，約為去年同期的十倍。公司在 9 月 30 日公布財報時，預估截至 11 月的當季每股盈餘約為 38 美元。
市場預估，美光 2027 會計年度自由現金流可望達到 1,400 億美元，高於上一年度的 590 億美元。自由現金流已扣除資本支出，若預測實現，意味公司在投資製程與產能後，仍可能保有可觀資金。
花旗分析師 Atif Malik 指出，美光 2027 會計年度資本支出將明顯增加，花旗估計約為 550 億美元，主要用於製程升級與產能擴張。
不過，在有利的產業環境下，公司仍預期產生大量自由現金流，並可在 12 月回購限制解除後，提高股東回饋。
瑞銀分析師 Tim Arcuri 則認為，美光的投資焦點已轉向記憶體景氣的延續時間、AI 推論對記憶體價值的提升，以及資本回饋能力。
Arcuri 預估，美光在 2027、2028 與 2029 曆年的自由現金流，可能分別達到約 1,550 億、2,250 億與 2,050 億美元。
他推算，公司未來兩年可能買回相當於約三成股本的股票，至 2029 年累計甚至可能接近一半。
不過，這項推估仍取決於現金流能否實現、回購授權及執行決策，以及實際買回時的股價。
美光資產負債表也明顯改善。
截至今年 8 月底，公司持有約 730 億美元現金及約當現金，債務約 50 億美元，淨現金約 680 億美元，相當於報導當時市值約 7%。
依報導採用的股價計算，美光過去 12 個月每股盈餘約為 75 美元，本益比約 11 倍。若以 2027 會計年度預估每股盈餘約 175 美元估算，預估本益比約為 5 倍。
然而，這項低估值建立在獲利維持高檔的預期上，市場關注的仍是記憶體價格與需求能否延續強勢。
12 月回購限制解除後，美光有機會透過擴大庫藏股支撐股價，但實際規模與持續性仍取決於營運表現。若記憶體價格意外下滑，現金流與回購能力也可能隨之減弱。
paras_en: Barron's reports that Micron (MU‑US) share‑buyback restrictions will expire on December 9, which could support the recently pressured stock. If earnings and free cash flow meet expectations, the company’s potential buyback size for the fiscal year ending August 2027 could reach $100 billion, roughly 10% of its market value at the time of reporting.
This potential upside emerges as the market re‑evaluates how long the memory price‑increase cycle can last.

Japanese NAND giant Kioxia announced a cautious outlook on Monday (the 2nd), dragging Micron down nearly 6% on Monday; on Tuesday, as the broader market recovered, Micron closed up 2.58% at $855.10 per share, up 171.10% year‑to‑date.

Micron previously received about $6 billion in U.S. CHIPS Act subsidies to support new memory fab construction, including in New York State, but the subsidy strictly limits share repurchases, allowing the company to buy back stock only to offset equity dilution from employee stock awards.
Consequently, for the fiscal year ending August 2026, Micron repurchased only about $650 million of its own shares.
Starting December 9 this year, Micron will be able to execute buybacks over the next three years roughly in line with its free cash flow, opening room to increase shareholder returns.
The company raised its share‑repurchase authorization by $33 billion on October 8, bringing the total to $352 billion, and said its long‑term goal is to return 100% of excess cash to shareholders.
However, excess cash must still consider operating needs, capital reserves and other uses, and cannot be equated directly with all free cash flow.
Micron’s confidence to expand buybacks stems from profit growth driven by rising memory demand and prices.

Adjusted earnings per share for Q4, ending August this year, were $33.42, about ten times the same quarter last year. When Micron released its September 30 earnings, it forecasted Q3 EPS of roughly $38.

The market estimates Micron’s FY2027 free cash flow could reach $140 billion, up from $59 billion the prior year. Free cash flow is calculated after capital expenditures, so if realized, it implies substantial cash remaining after investing in processes and capacity.
Citi analyst Atif Malik notes Micron’s FY2027 capital spending will rise sharply, estimating about $55 billion, mainly for process upgrades and capacity expansion.
Nevertheless, in a favorable industry backdrop, the company still expects to generate large free cash flow and can boost shareholder returns once the December buyback lockup lifts.
UBS analyst Tim Arcuri believes Micron’s investment focus has shifted to the duration of the memory cycle, AI inference’s impact on memory value, and capital return capability.
Arcuri projects Micron’s free cash flow for calendar years 2027, 2028 and 2029 could be about $155 billion, $225 billion and $205 billion respectively.
He estimates the company may repurchase shares equal to roughly 30% of equity over the next two years, potentially approaching 50% cumulatively by 2029.
However, this estimate still depends on cash flow realization, buyback authorizations and execution decisions, and the stock price at the time of repurchase.
Micron’s balance sheet has also improved markedly.

As of the end of August, the company held roughly $73 billion in cash and cash equivalents, about $5 billion in debt, leaving net cash of about $68 billion, roughly 7% of its market value at the time of reporting.

Based on the stock price used in the report, Micron’s trailing twelve‑month EPS was about $75, giving a P/E of roughly 11×. Using the FY2027 EPS estimate of about $175 yields an implied P/E of around 5×.
Nonetheless, this low valuation rests on expectations of sustained high earnings; the market remains focused on whether memory prices and demand can stay strong.

After the December lockup lifts, Micron could use an expanded treasury‑stock program to support its share price, but the actual scale and durability will still depend on operating performance. If memory prices unexpectedly fall, cash flow and buyback capacity could weaken.

items.title: AI投資恐慌過頭？野村揭科技巨頭自由現金流轉負真相：資料中心獲利潛力仍強
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資持續擴大，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 與Google(GOOGL-US) 等科技巨頭雖然大舉投入資料中心建設，卻也因資本支出激增，面臨自由現金流（FCF）轉負的壓力，進而引發市場對AI投資獲利能力的疑慮。不過，野村證券認為，投資人可能混淆企業獲利與現金流的差異，將大型科技公司自由現金流轉負解讀為AI無法獲利，導致近期科技股賣壓過度，尤其半導體類股可能遭到錯殺。
根據野村證券11月2日報告，近期科技股遭遇賣壓，主要來自兩項市場疑慮：一是AI業務可能侵蝕科技巨頭既有的傳統業務，二是大規模資本支出使自由現金流轉為負值。
然而，野村認為，這兩項擔憂未必構成利空。大型科技公司無法削減AI投資，反而代表算力需求仍然強勁，對半導體產業而言並非壞事；至於自由現金流轉負，則是資本支出與投資收益認列時間不同所造成的結果，不能直接視為企業獲利能力惡化。
野村強調，自由現金流轉負並不會改變半導體需求，也不會動搖半導體公司的估值基礎。如果市場因科技巨頭現金流壓力而持續拋售相關股票，反而可能為長期投資人創造布局機會。

雲端業務獲利持續改善　自由現金流轉負不等於虧損

野村指出，AI資料中心投資具有高度獲利潛力，目前大型科技公司的自由現金流轉負，主要反映資本支出與收益入帳之間的時間差，類似典型的J曲線效應。
企業在興建資料中心時，資本支出會立即反映為現金流出，但相關資產的折舊與營收，則會在設備投入使用後的5至20年間陸續認列。因此，短期現金流可能承受壓力，並不代表相關投資無法創造獲利。
第三季財報也顯示，主要雲端業者的營運表現仍相當強勁。
亞馬遜AWS第三季營收達460億美元，年增39%，創2021年以來最快增速，營業利益率則從去年同期的34.6%升至38.7%。
微軟Azure在2027會計年度第一季營收年增48%；Google Cloud第三季營收達307億美元，年增103%，營業利益率也從去年同期的23.7%大幅升至36.2%。
三大雲端服務商第三季雲端業務營收合計約1,100億美元，年增約56%。
野村認為，這些數據顯示，大型科技公司的營運收入持續成長，雲端業務獲利能力也在資本支出增加之際同步改善，與市場將自由現金流轉負解讀為企業不賺錢的說法並不相符。

三大因素推動AI投資　科技巨頭難以踩煞車

野村進一步指出，大型科技公司難以放緩AI基礎建設投資，背後有三項結構性因素。
首先，AI推論所需算力持續增加。推理模型與AI代理每次回應所消耗的運算資源，遠高於模型訓練階段，訓練完成後的強化學習同樣需要大量算力。若基礎設施不足，將直接限制AI模型的商業化規模。
其次，AI服務的營收成長瓶頸在於運算容量，而非市場需求不足。截至第三季末，Google Cloud未履行訂單金額達5,608億美元，AWS約4,960億美元，微軟商業剩餘履約義務（RPO）則達6,770億美元，年增73%。
微軟也透露，第三季實際資本支出低於原先規劃的500億美元，原因是第三方產能延遲，而非客戶需求疲弱。這也反映目前AI基礎建設的主要限制仍在供給端。
第三，企業客戶與AI平台之間的黏著度持續提高。當企業將工作流程、資料及AI代理深度整合至特定模型後，轉換平台的成本也會大幅增加。
野村認為，未來三年的算力建設將大致決定市場競爭格局，科技巨頭若此時放慢投資，真正付出的代價可能不是短期現金流壓力，而是失去長期市場地位。

合資、租賃與預售現金流　科技巨頭有多種融資選擇

針對自由現金流轉負的問題，野村整理出大型科技公司可能採取的四種策略，認為最可能的發展方向是維持目前投資速度，同時透過外部融資及資產結構調整緩解現金流壓力，而非直接凍結資本支出。
第一種方式是維持甚至加速投資。短期內自由現金流可能進一步惡化，但隨著資料中心陸續完工並投入營運，投資增速放緩後，相關設施將開始創造現金流，帶動自由現金流改善。因此，股價若因此下跌，將是長期投資人的機會。
第二種方式是凍結資本支出。雖然能立即改善現金流，但也可能導致未來營收大幅萎縮，削弱市場競爭力，並對半導體需求造成負面影響。野村認為，這種情境發生的機率極低。
第三種方式是透過合資企業與營運租賃分攤建設成本，由合作夥伴出資興建基礎設施，科技公司再透過租賃方式使用，將部分資本支出轉化為未來租金支出。
Meta(META-US) 在Hyperion資料中心專案中已採取類似模式，由Meta持股20%、Blue Owl管理的基金持股80%，並成立規模270億美元的特殊目的公司（SPV），發行取得標普全球評級A+的債券，再透過四年期、可續約的營運租賃協議使用相關設施。
第四種方式則是將未來現金流部分變現，將企業客戶已簽約的未來收入出售給退休基金、保險公司等長期投資人，提前取得資金，同時保留設備營運及客戶關係。
野村以甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的融資安排為例，指出該公司結合租賃、特殊目的公司、客戶預付款及客戶自行採購硬體等方式，維持原有投資計畫。
Oracle第三季已收到114億美元客戶預付款，顯示科技巨頭可以透過融資工具處理現金流壓力，而非被迫削減投資。

野村：短期算力供過於求風險有限　半導體仍有支撐

至於市場擔心AI資料中心大量興建，未來可能出現算力供過於求，導致每吉瓦（GW）算力創造的營收低於預期，野村認為，短期內發生的機率仍然偏低。
即使部分算力供給超過需求，大型科技公司仍可透過長期供應合約鎖定價格、將閒置算力轉用於模型訓練，以及適度調整資本支出等方式因應，對整體半導體需求的衝擊有限。
即使出現嚴重供過於求的極端情境，野村估計，記憶體晶片廠商約有50%至70%的出貨量已透過長期協議鎖定，且享有最低利潤率保障，相關業務的營業利益率估計仍可維持在60%以上，具備一定抗風險能力。
目前市場數據也尚未顯示明顯供過於求。第三季主要雲端業者營收成長全面加速，微軟資本支出低於原先計畫，更是受到第三方產能不足影響，而非需求減弱。
野村建議投資人持續追蹤雲端業務成長速度、GPU租賃價格及未履行訂單金額的變化，作為判斷AI基礎建設需求是否出現轉折的重要指標。

items.title: 美光股價自三個月低點回神 華爾街看好還有90%上漲空間
items.title_en: Micron stock rebounds from three‑month low, Wall Street sees 90% upside
paras: 美光(MU-US)股價周二(3日)從三個月低點反彈2.6%，止住連三日頹勢。這與分析師看法天差地遠，目前華爾街分析師的平均目標價代表仍有90%的上漲空間。
美光周二終場上漲2.6%至每股855.10美元，該股截至周一已經連三個交易日都下跌至少5%，周一最終收在三個月來最低水準。。
這波跌勢可能令華爾街許多分析師感到困惑，追蹤美光的分析師平均目標價為1,631美元，代表還有約90%上漲空間。
D.A. Davidson分析師Gil Luria可能是華爾街最看好美光的一位，他給出的目標價高達3,000美元，意味著股價還有約250%的上漲空間。他認為市場究竟忽略了什麼？
Luria上個月在一份研究報告中說：「我們相信，隨著投資人逐漸認識到美光的技術領先地位，以及由此形成的寬廣競爭護城河，他們將更願意給予美光符合整體市場水準的本益比。」
美光自12月9日起將可大舉實施庫藏股計畫，這項措施可能為股價帶來亟需的提振。但在這之前，市場唯一關注的依然是對人工智慧(AI)的疑慮。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) stock on Tuesday (the 3rd) rebounded 2.6% from a three‑month low, halting a three‑day decline. This is far from analysts’ views; the average Wall Street target price still implies about 90% upside.
Micron closed up 2.6% on Tuesday at $855.10 per share. The stock had fallen at least 5% for three consecutive trading days through Monday, which ended at its lowest level in three months.
This decline may have puzzled many Wall Street analysts; the average target price among those covering Micron is $1,631, indicating roughly 90% upside.
D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria may be the most bullish on Micron on Wall Street, assigning a target price of $3,000, implying about 250% upside. He wonders what the market is overlooking.

Luria said in a research note last month: “We believe that as investors increasingly recognize Micron’s technology leadership and the broad competitive moat it creates, they will be willing to grant Micron a price‑to‑earnings multiple in line with the broader market.”

Micron will be able to launch a large‑scale share‑repurchase program starting December 9, which could provide a needed boost to the stock. Until then, the market’s sole focus remains concerns about artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: 蘋果跌近2% 輝達重登全球市值王！AI投資疑慮尚未完全散去
items.title_en: Apple Slides Nearly 2% as Nvidia Reclaims Global Market‑Cap Crown; AI Investment Concerns Still Linger
paras: 《巴隆週刊》週二 (3 日) 報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 股價反彈，超越蘋果 (AAPL-US)，重新登上全球市值最高企業寶座。這場龍頭換位，反映市場對人工智慧 (AI) 投資的疑慮暫時緩和，也凸顯蘋果最新營收展望未能支撐其偏高估值。
輝達週二股價升幅超2%，報每股 206.69 美元，市值約 4.98 兆美元；蘋果則下跌約 2%，報每股 331.90 美元，市值約 4.84 兆美元。
上週五在 AI 類股重挫之際，蘋果甫取代輝達成為全球市值龍頭，如今排名迅速逆轉。
輝達被視為 AI 基礎建設熱潮的主要受惠者，相較之下，蘋果對這波 AI 投資循環的直接曝險較低，因此兩家公司近期的消長，也成為觀察市場風險偏好的窗口。
輝達週二上漲並沒有明確的單一催化因素，但市場對科技巨頭龐大 AI 支出的擔憂，可能暫時有所緩解。投資人等待美國期中選舉結果之際，費城半導體指數勁揚 2.63%，那斯達克指數上漲 0.83%，標普 500 指數終結連三日跌勢。
另一項受到關注的消息，是黃仁勳對 Marvell (MRVL-US) 與 Lumentum (LITE-US) 合併案的態度。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，兩家公司週一宣布交易前，Marvell 執行長墨菲 (Matthew Murphy) 與 Lumentum 執行長赫爾斯頓 (Michael Hurlston) 曾與黃仁勳通話，並獲得他的支持。
Marvell 與 Lumentum 分別布局資料中心連網晶片及光通訊元件。隨著 AI 資料中心規模擴大，高速資料傳輸已成為支撐運算效能的重要環節，市場也擔心供應能力跟不上建置需求。
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) 週一股價暴跌約 13%，週二小幅回穩 0.33%。Lumentum (LITE-US)則續跌超 0.6%。
分析指出，Marvell 與 Lumentum  供應商整合資源，可能有利於輝達的供應鏈布局。
輝達今年稍早已分別向 Marvell 與 Lumentum 投資 20 億美元，取得可轉換特別股，顯示其對兩家公司技術與產能的重視。
不過，黃仁勳支持合併的消息，仍不足以證明市場對 AI 投資回報的疑慮已經消退。
這次市值排名迅速翻轉，更直接的原因可能在於蘋果自身。蘋果最新一季財報表現穩健，但營收展望未能充分化解投資人對高估值的擔憂，股價因此承壓。
根據 FactSet 調查，蘋果週二的預估本益比約為 36 倍，較過去五年平均高出約 5 倍。
這代表投資人已為其未來獲利支付較高價格，也使市場對科技巨頭後續成長展望提出更高要求；即使當季業績穩健，只要財測未能滿足期待，股價仍可能面臨修正壓力。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Tuesday the 3rd that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares rebounded, overtaking Apple (AAPL-US) to retake the title of world’s most valuable company. This leadership swap reflects a temporary easing of market worries over AI investments and highlights that Apple’s latest revenue outlook failed to justify its lofty valuation.
Nvidia rose over 2% on Tuesday, trading at $206.69 per share and a market cap of about $4.98 trillion; Apple fell roughly 2% to $331.90 per share, with a market cap near $4.84 trillion.
Last Friday, amid a sharp drop in AI‑related stocks, Apple had just displaced Nvidia as the global market‑cap leader, a ranking that has now flipped back quickly.

Nvidia is seen as a primary beneficiary of the AI infrastructure boom, whereas Apple’s direct exposure to this AI investment cycle is lower, making the recent fortunes of the two firms a barometer of market risk appetite.

Nvidia’s Tuesday gain had no single clear catalyst, but concerns over massive AI spending by tech giants may have eased temporarily. While investors await the U.S. mid‑term election results, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 2.63%, the Nasdaq rose 0.83%, and the S&P 500 ended a three‑day losing streak.
Another story drawing attention is Jensen Huang’s stance on the Marvell (MRVL-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) merger.
Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that before the deal was announced on Monday, Marvell CEO Matthew Murphy and Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston spoke with Jensen Huang and received his backing.

Marvell and Lumentum each focus on data‑center networking chips and photonic components. As AI data‑center scale expands, high‑speed data transfer has become a critical piece of computing performance, and the market worries supply may not keep pace with demand.
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) plunged about 13% on Monday and steadied modestly by 0.33% on Tuesday, while Lumentum (LITE-US) continued to fall more than 0.6%.
Analysts note that the integration of Marvell and Lumentum’s supply capabilities could benefit Nvidia’s supply‑chain positioning.
Earlier this year Nvidia invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum, acquiring convertible preferred shares, underscoring its interest in their technology and capacity.
However, Huang’s support for the merger alone does not prove that market doubts over AI investment returns have vanished.

The rapid reversal in market‑cap rankings is likely driven more directly by Apple itself. Apple’s latest quarterly earnings were solid, but its revenue outlook failed to fully allay investor concerns over its high valuation, keeping the stock under pressure.
FactSet data shows Apple’s estimated price‑to‑earnings ratio on Tuesday was about 36×, roughly five multiples above its five‑year average.

This indicates investors are paying a premium for Apple’s future profits, raising expectations for the tech giant’s growth; even with steady quarterly results, a disappointing outlook could still trigger stock‑price corrections.

items.title: AI股不再是華爾街寵兒？最受追捧股票跑輸冷門股、創近30年極端紀錄
items.title_en: AI Stocks Are No Longer Wall Street Darlings? Most Favored Shares Lag Behind Obscure Stocks, Setting Near‑30‑Year Extreme Record
paras: 美股市場近期出現罕見現象，過去深受華爾街分析師追捧的人工智慧（AI）概念股，近幾個月遭遇猛烈賣壓，股價表現反而落後於原本最不受分析師青睞的個股。市場資金偏好出現反轉，也讓華爾街開始關注，這是否意味著企業獲利前景或整體經濟環境正醞釀重大轉變。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，Piper Sandler首席投資策略師Kantrowitz的分析指出，過去一年，華爾街評等最高的股票相較於評等最低的股票，表現落後的程度已躋身1990年代中期以來最極端的三次紀錄之一。
這項分析將標普11大產業中，分析師買進評等占比最高與最低的個股進行比較，藉此衡量市場最受追捧與最不被看好的股票之間的相對表現。
Kantrowitz及其團隊指出，華爾街最看好的股票出現如此大幅度的落後表現並不常見，過去類似情況通常發生在企業獲利前景或整體經濟環境開始轉變之際。
回顧過去三次類似情況，2000年10月，聯準會（Fed）寬鬆政策帶動夏季股市反彈後，隨著投資人逐漸意識到網路泡沫正在破裂，原本受到追捧的科技股開始失去動能。
2009年2月，全球經濟在金融海嘯後逐漸觸底，先前遭到重挫、分析師評等偏低的景氣循環股大幅反彈，漲勢超越市場原本看好的個股。
到了2020年10月，隨著市場預期新冠肺炎（COVID-19）疫苗即將獲准上市，投資人開始押注經濟重新開放，帶動相關股票走強。
從目前華爾街分析師最看好的10檔股票來看，資訊科技與通訊服務類股占據多數席次。
其中，雲端網路設備商Arista網路(ANET-US) 及電信與衛星通訊服務供應商EchoStar ECHO-US) 是分析師評等最高的兩檔股票，給予這兩家公司買進評等的分析師比例均超過87%。
相較之下，根據Piper Sandler的資料，保德信金融(PRU-US) 與普徠仕集團(TROW-US) 則名列分析師最不看好的股票之首，目前沒有任何分析師給予這兩家公司買進評等。
paras_en: The U.S. equity market has recently shown a rare phenomenon: AI‑related stocks, which have long been championed by Wall Street analysts, have faced heavy selling pressure over the past few months, and their price performance has fallen behind that of the stocks that analysts originally disliked the most. This reversal in capital preference has prompted Wall Street to wonder whether it signals a major shift in corporate earnings outlook or the broader economic environment.

According to MarketWatch, Piper Sandler chief investment strategist Kantrowitz noted that over the past year the highest‑rated stocks by Wall Street analysts have underperformed the lowest‑rated stocks to a degree that ranks among the three most extreme gaps since the mid‑1990s.

The analysis compared, across S&P’s eleven sectors, the stocks with the highest and lowest analyst buy‑rating percentages, using this to gauge the relative performance of the market’s most‑watched versus least‑favored shares.

Kantrowitz and his team said that such a pronounced lag among Wall Street’s top‑rated stocks is uncommon; historically, similar gaps have tended to appear when corporate profit prospects or the overall economic backdrop begin to change.

Looking back at the three prior episodes, in October 2000 the Federal Reserve’s accommodative policy sparked a summer market rally, but as investors gradually realized the internet bubble was bursting, the once‑celebrated tech stocks lost momentum.

In February 2009, as the global economy bottomed out after the financial crisis, cyclical stocks that had been heavily hit and received low analyst ratings rebounded sharply, outpacing the stocks that had been the market’s favorites.
By October 2020, expectations that a COVID‑19 vaccine would soon be approved led investors to bet on an economic reopening, lifting the related stocks.
Among the ten stocks currently rated most favorably by Wall Street analysts, information‑technology and communication‑services companies dominate the list.

The top‑rated stocks are cloud‑network equipment maker Arista Networks (ANET‑US) and telecom and satellite‑service provider EchoStar (ECHO‑US), each receiving buy ratings from more than 87% of analysts covering them.
In contrast, Piper Sandler data show that Prudential Financial (PRU‑US) and T. Rowe Price Group (TROW‑US) rank as the least‑favored stocks, with no analyst assigning a buy rating to either company.

items.title: 〈財報〉美超微Q1超預期 財測強勁 盤後大漲7%
items.title_en: <Earnings> Super Micro Q1 Beats Expectations, Strong Outlook Fuels 7% After‑Hours Surge
paras: 美超微 (Super Micro Computer)(SMCI-US) 週二(3日)盤後公布 2027 會計年度第一季財報，營收與獲利雙雙超越華爾街預期，並提出優於市場預估的第二季財測，帶動盤後股價大漲7%。
公司表示，預估第二季營收將介於195億至215億美元之間，高於分析師預估的163.5億美元。
執行長梁見後在聲明中表示，「美超微轉型為全面性的 AI 與 IT 資料中心解決方案供應商的進程持續加速，2027 會計年度第一季營收創下199億美元的歷史新高。」
他進一步表示，「資料中心模組化解決方案 (Data Center Building Block Solutions) 正為客戶創造顯著價值，服務範圍涵蓋GW級資料中心到單一貨櫃式 POD。再加上我們持續擴展的軟體、主動式服務及網路解決方案，不僅提升了獲利能力，也為股東創造長期價值。」
「透過與重要企業建立合作夥伴關係，以及持續擴大全球產能，我們正讓 AI 基礎設施的部署速度更快、正常運作時間更長，同時讓客戶能以更具成本效益的方式取得相關解決方案。」

Q1 財報關鍵數據 v.s. FactSet預估


營收：199.5 億美元 v.s. 175.3 億美元
調整後EPS：1.81 美元 v.s. 1.23 美元


美超微第一季每股盈餘 (EPS) 為1.81美元，營收199.5億美元，不僅大幅優於華爾街預測，也高於公司先前公布的初步財報數據。
第一季毛利率超過12.8%，同樣高於公司先前公布的12%至12.5%初步數據。
過去一個月，美超微股價重挫27%。此前，Gartner 發布報告指出，由於投資資本報酬率不足，到2030年，80%新興雲端服務商 (neocloud) 可能停止營運。
消息公布後，新雲端服務商 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 與 Nebius (NBIS-US) 股價大幅下跌，過去一個月分別下挫40%與37%。其中，CoreWeave 是美超微的客戶。
美超微今年以來股價表現不佳，過去12個月重挫38%，市場主要疑慮在於公司的獲利能力。
此外，在財報公布前，華爾街也密切關注其他可能對公司造成壓力的因素，其中之一便是零組件成本對利潤率的影響。
數字皆為截稿前更新
paras_en: Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) released its fiscal 2027 first‑quarter results after the market closed on Tuesday (the 3rd), with both revenue and profit surpassing Wall Street forecasts and an outlook for the second quarter that exceeds market estimates, driving the stock up 7% in after‑hours trading.
The company said it expects second‑quarter revenue to be between $19.5 billion and $21.5 billion, above analysts’ estimate of $16.35 billion.

CEO Liang Jianhou said in a statement, "Super Micro’s transformation into a comprehensive AI and IT data‑center solutions provider is accelerating, and fiscal 2027 first‑quarter revenue set a new historical high of $19.9 billion."

He added, "Data Center Building Block Solutions are delivering significant value to customers, covering everything from gigawatt‑scale data centers to single‑container PODs. Coupled with our expanding software, proactive services and networking solutions, we are not only boosting profitability but also creating long‑term value for shareholders."

"By forging partnerships with key enterprises and continuously expanding global capacity, we are speeding up AI infrastructure deployment, increasing uptime, and enabling customers to obtain solutions more cost‑effectively," he said.

Q1 key figures versus FactSet estimates: Revenue $19.95 billion vs. $17.53 billion; Adjusted EPS $1.81 vs. $1.23. Super Micro’s first‑quarter EPS was $1.81 on revenue of $19.95 billion, far beating Wall Street forecasts and higher than the company’s preliminary numbers previously released.
First‑quarter gross margin topped 12.8%, also above the company’s earlier preliminary range of 12%‑12.5%.

Over the past month, Super Micro’s share price has plunged 27%. Earlier, Gartner reported that due to insufficient return on investment, 80% of emerging cloud service providers (neocloud) could cease operations by 2030.
Following the news, shares of new cloud providers CoreWeave (CRWV-US) and Nebius (NBIS-US) fell sharply, down 40% and 37% respectively over the past month. CoreWeave is a customer of Super Micro.
Super Micro’s stock has performed poorly this year, dropping 38% over the past 12 months, with the market’s main concern centered on the company’s profitability.
Additionally, ahead of the earnings release, Wall Street was closely watching other potential pressure points for the company, one of which is the impact of component costs on profit margins.
All figures are updated as of the deadline.

items.title: 台積電25年供電長約待送審 Pinnacle West規劃1.88GW供電
items.title_en: TSMC's 25-Year Power Supply Contract Awaiting Review; Pinnacle West Plans 1.88 GW Supply
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國電力公司Pinnacle West Capital(PNW-US)表示，已於10月與台積電(2330-TW)簽訂25年直接定價供電合約，將供應亞利桑那州晶片製造園區全面建成後約1.88GW的用電需求。公司預計近日將合約送交監管機關審查，仍待核准。
Pinnacle West總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城，透過旗下子公司在州內供電，業務涵蓋發電、輸電與配電，旗下擁有核能、天然氣、燃煤及太陽能等發電設施，以及輸配電線路、變電站與儲能設備。
這是Pinnacle West首份直接定價合約。台積電將提前投入資金，並提供信用擔保，讓電力公司能配合園區用電需求，安排電源及電網建設。公司強調，相關投資成本將由台積電承擔，不會轉由住宅用戶負擔。
執行長Theodore Geisler表示，台積電這筆1.88GW需求，已計入公司目前合計5.8GW的已承諾用電需求，也納入長期電力資源規畫。若台積電未來進一步擴建，雙方將再討論新增用電的供應安排。
Geisler指出，公司新增用電需求來自多個產業，其中製造業的貢獻高於資料中心，包括晶片製造及其他製造業。與台積電簽訂的合約，也可作為日後服務其他大型客戶的參考，目前公司正與其他等待供電的客戶協商。
這類合約通常要求客戶支付預付款、提供擔保，並訂定最低用電量、用電容量及提前終止合約的責任，讓電力公司在投入建設前，取得客戶的長期承諾。不過，其他協商案能否簽約，目前仍未確定。
隨著用電需求增加，輸電設施也必須同步擴建。公司指出，目前服務區域的輸電系統已無多餘可用容量，新增發電資源必須搭配新的輸電設施，才能可靠地接入電網。依最新規畫，至2041年，客戶全年用電量預估將增至約80,600GWh，超過目前兩倍；未來15年規畫新增近15GW電力資源及約2.6GW輸電容量。

paras_en: On November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. utility Pinnacle West Capital (PNW‑US) said it signed a 25‑year direct‑price power supply agreement with TSMC (2330‑TW) in October, to provide about 1.88 GW of electricity for the fully built chip‑manufacturing campus in Arizona. The company expects to submit the contract to regulators for approval in the near future, pending clearance.

Pinnacle West is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, and supplies power in the state through its subsidiaries. Its operations cover generation, transmission and distribution, with nuclear, natural‑gas, coal and solar generation assets, as well as transmission lines, substations and storage equipment.

This is Pinnacle West’s first direct‑price contract. TSMC will invest funds up front and provide credit guarantees so the utility can match the campus’s power needs and arrange generation and grid construction. The company stressed that the related investment costs will be borne by TSMC and will not be passed on to residential customers.

CEO Theodore Geisler said TSMC’s 1.88 GW demand has been added to the company’s currently pledged 5.8 GW of power commitments and is incorporated into its long‑term resource planning. If TSMC expands further in the future, the two parties will discuss additional supply arrangements.

Geisler noted that the new demand comes from multiple sectors, with manufacturing contributing more than data centers, including chip fabrication and other manufacturing. The contract with TSMC can serve as a reference for serving other large customers, and the company is currently negotiating with other clients awaiting power supply.

Such contracts typically require customers to pay advance payments, provide guarantees, and set minimum usage, capacity and early‑termination responsibilities, giving the utility a long‑term commitment before investing in construction. However, it remains uncertain whether other negotiated deals will be signed.

As power demand grows, transmission infrastructure must expand in tandem. The company said the existing transmission system in its service area has no spare capacity, so new generation must be paired with new transmission facilities to connect reliably to the grid. Under the latest plan, annual customer electricity consumption is projected to rise to about 80,600 GWh by 2041 – roughly double today – and the next 15 years will see the addition of nearly 15 GW of generation and about 2.6 GW of transmission capacity.

items.title_en: Silicon Wafer Price Rise | GlobalWafers Near Full Capacity, Q4 Still at Old Prices, 2027 the Validation Point
paras: 2026年11月03日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 矽晶圓大廠環球晶(6488-TW)今（3）日宣布，董事會通過規劃發行最高5億美元、約新台幣160億元的私募可轉換公司債，由美國記憶體大廠美光Micron(MU-US)擔任唯一應募人，落實雙方7月宣布的策略資金合作，並強化美國在地矽晶圓供應。
這檔可轉債為無擔保債券，期限10年，票面年利率0.5%，仍須提交股東會決議。通過後，董事會可在決議日起一年內，視市場狀況與公司需求一次發行。
美光7月宣布投入最高30億美元強化美國半導體供應鏈，其中5億美元以策略資金支持環球晶美國德州Sherman廠的12吋矽晶圓產能，雙方也規劃簽訂10年供應協議。
既然已有10年長約，為何不採預付款，而要發可轉債？環球晶在今日法說會上說明，預付款通常直接連結未來的產品採購與交貨，這筆策略資金的用途更廣，除了支持供應關係，也涵蓋美國營運發展與供應能力提升。
環球晶表示，可轉債在發行時仍屬債務工具，與現金增資不同，不會立即增加普通股股數；公司可取得長天期資金，現金利息負擔也相對較低。董事長徐秀蘭指出，美光願意透過可轉債參與環球晶的長期發展，反映雙方多年累積的信任，以及對環球晶未來成長的信心。
環球晶美國德州廠的進度也在加快。公司指出，德州廠一期主要設備安裝大致完成，數家一線客戶已完成認證，月出貨量連續4個月創新高，洽談美國產能長約的客戶也持續增加。
徐秀蘭表示，半導體需求正在擴散，但合格產能無法一夕建立，新產能還要面對高額資本支出、設備交期與客戶認證。德州廠二期的建物與部分基礎設施已經到位，後續擴充的資本效率和速度都可望優於一期，但實際投資仍要視客戶承諾、獲利與政府支持而定。
財務方面，環球晶第三季營收149億元，季減2.3%，毛利率20%，每股純益3.13元；前三季每股純益15元，已逼近去年全年的15.29元。公司指出，營收下滑主要受7月義大利Novara廠火災影響，若沒有這起事件，單季營收可季增逾12%。
環球晶9月完成14億美元GDR發行，第三季底由第二季底的淨負債186億元轉為淨現金263億元，財務體質明顯改善。
展望後市，環球晶表示，扣除仍在放量的新產線，現有12吋產能已經滿載，8吋與6吋也接近滿載，預期2027年矽晶圓供需將比2026年更緊。徐秀蘭指出，第四季表現可望優於第三季，但多數訂單仍維持舊價；2027年第一季起，除了新產能陸續貢獻，平均售價也將優於今年第四季。
不過，漲價並非全面到位。徐秀蘭坦言，部分客戶手上晶圓庫存較多，對價格調漲態度較為強硬，公司將依產品規格、供需狀況、合約到期時間與個別客戶情況逐案協商。

paras_en: On November 3, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – GlobalWafers (6488-TW), a major silicon wafer manufacturer, announced today that its board approved a plan to issue up to US$500 million (about NT$16 billion) of private placement convertible bonds, with U.S. memory giant Micron (MU-US) as the sole subscriber, implementing the strategic capital cooperation announced in July and strengthening Micron’s local silicon wafer supply in the United States.

The convertible bond is an unsecured debt instrument with a 10‑year term and a 0.5% annual coupon, and still requires shareholder approval. Once approved, the board may issue the bonds within one year from the resolution date, depending on market conditions and company needs.

In July, Micron announced a maximum US$3 billion investment to bolster the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, of which US$500 million will be strategic capital to support GlobalWafers’ 12‑inch wafer capacity at its Sherman plant in Texas, and the two parties also plan to sign a 10‑year supply agreement.

Given the existing 10‑year contract, why not use advance payments instead of convertible bonds? GlobalWafers explained at today’s briefing that advance payments are usually tied directly to future product purchases and deliveries, whereas this strategic capital has broader uses, covering not only supply relationships but also U.S. operational development and capacity upgrades.

GlobalWafers said that convertible bonds remain debt instruments at issuance, unlike cash equity injections, and do not immediately increase the number of common shares; the company can obtain long‑term funding with relatively low cash interest costs. Chairperson Hsu Hsiu‑lan noted that Micron’s willingness to participate via convertible bonds reflects years of mutual trust and confidence in GlobalWafers’ future growth.

Progress at GlobalWafers’ Texas plant is accelerating. The company said Phase 1 equipment installation is largely complete, several Tier‑1 customers have finished qualification, monthly shipments have set new highs for four consecutive months, and negotiations for long‑term U.S. capacity contracts are increasing.

Hsu Hsiu‑lan said semiconductor demand is expanding, but qualified capacity cannot be built overnight; new capacity still faces high capital expenditures, equipment lead times, and customer qualification. Phase 2 building and some infrastructure are already in place, and the subsequent expansion’s capital efficiency and speed are expected to surpass Phase 1, though actual investment will depend on customer commitments, profitability, and government support.

Financially, GlobalWafers posted Q3 revenue of NT$14.9 billion, down 2.3% quarter‑over‑quarter, with a 20% gross margin and earnings per share of NT$3.13; earnings per share for the first three quarters total NT$15, approaching last year’s full‑year NT$15.29. The company said the revenue dip was mainly due to a fire at its Novara plant in Italy in July; without that incident, quarterly revenue would have risen over 12% YoY.

In September, GlobalWafers completed a US$1.4 billion GDR issuance, turning net debt of NT$18.6 billion at the end of Q2 into net cash of NT$26.3 billion by the end of Q3, markedly improving its financial health.

Looking ahead, GlobalWafers said that excluding new lines that are still ramping up, existing 12‑inch capacity is already fully utilized, and 8‑inch and 6‑inch lines are near full load, expecting wafer supply‑demand to be tighter in 2027 than in 2026. Hsu Hsiu‑lan noted Q4 performance should exceed Q3, but most orders will remain at old prices; from Q1 2027 onward, as new capacity comes online, average selling prices are expected to be higher than in Q4 2026.

However, price hikes are not universal. Hsu Hsiu‑lan admitted that some customers hold sizable wafer inventories and are resistant to price increases, so the company will negotiate case‑by‑case based on product specifications, supply‑demand balance, contract expiry, and individual customer situations.

items.title: 〈環宇法說〉環宇-KY前3季EPS達3.91元 Q4、明年成長動能續強
items.title_en: <Huan Yu Legal Commentary> Huan Yu-KY Q3 EPS Reaches NT$3.91; Q4 and Next Year Growth Momentum Remains Strong
paras: 三五族光通訊股環宇-KY(4991-TW)今(3)日舉行法說會，也公告今(2026)年第3季財報，受惠於自有品牌光電元件(AOC)出貨強勁回升，營收占比由61%躍升至71%，單季稅後純益1.59億元、季增44.5%，年增增逾10.3倍，EPS 1.33元，累計今年EPS為 3.91元。
環宇-KY今日舉行線上法說，第3季單季營收為8.45億元、季增9.7%、年增55.4%，主要受惠於AOC出貨量增；毛利率47%、季增3.7個百分點，與去年同期47.4%約持平；營益率19.3%，季增65.9%、年增56.1%；稅後淨利歸屬母公司1.59億元，累計前3季稅後純益4.65億元，EPS 3.91元，較去年淨損1.45元轉虧為盈。
環宇-KY總執行長暨總裁安寶信表示，獲利增加主要因AOC產品占比提升為71%，季增約10%不僅提高毛利率，也提升業績增長，同時在AI DC(資訊中心)需求，加上射頻元件的代工也帶動AOC的營收成長。
此外，安寶信指出，加上磷化銦(InP)基板與磊晶供應回穩，出貨量顯著增加，公司調漲AOC價格以反映原料成本上揚，且存貨跌價損失減少下，也挹注毛利率、RF晶圓代工營收則季減7.6%，光電晶圓代工營收季減37%，環宇-KY在策略上也調整接單，聚焦重要客戶訂單出貨。
展望未來，法人預估公司預估第4季營收3,000萬至3,400萬美元(約新台幣9.52億-10.79億元)，季增有望達到雙位數成長，毛利率維持46%至50%高檔，營業費用因CW Laser 開發進度遞延，相關攤銷費用預計自第4季開始認列，預期營業費用將提高至760萬至860萬美元。
安寶信表示，隨著AOC需求持續強勁，加上轉投資資威利富公司取得額外產能下，有望維持出貨產能強勁。在原料基板部分，環宇-KY預估磷化銦基板價格將持續上漲且供貨緊縮，受到美中政治性因素影響較大，公司目前與合作夥伴採取迅速出貨策略因應，2027年供應已透過長約鎖定，但2028年仍在協商。
另隨著Marvell收購光通訊大廠Lumentum，環宇-KY看好整體光通訊市場展望，目前在基板料件供貨無虞，預期可供至2027年出貨暢通，安寶信看好第4季與明(2027)年運營將持續向上成長。
法人表示，環宇-KY在今、明2年市場展望維持穩定成長看法不變，在200G PD產品線部分，也因非中國基板供應商產能風險較大，環宇-KY將導入第2家基板供貨來源，預計2027年第2季將能顯著放量成長，看好第4季與明年營運都會持續向上增長。
paras_en: Huan Yu-KY (4991‑TW), a leading optical communications stock, held a legal briefing today (the 3rd) and also released its Q3 2026 financial results. Benefiting from a strong rebound in shipments of its own‑brand optical‑electronic components (AOC), the share of revenue from AOC rose from 61% to 71%. Net profit after tax for the quarter was NT$159 million, up 44.5% quarter‑over‑quarter and more than 10.3‑fold year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$1.33. Cumulative EPS for the year now stands at NT$3.91.

In the online briefing, Huan Yu‑KY reported Q3 revenue of NT$845 million, a 9.7% quarterly increase and a 55.4% year‑over‑year rise, driven mainly by higher AOC shipments. Gross margin was 47%, up 3.7 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and roughly flat with the 47.4% recorded a year ago. Operating margin reached 19.3%, up 65.9% quarter‑over‑quarter and 56.1% year‑over‑year. Net profit attributable to the parent was NT$159 million, bringing cumulative net profit for the first three quarters to NT$465 million and EPS to NT$3.91, a turnaround from last year’s loss of NT$1.45 per share.

CEO and President An Baoxin said the profit increase was mainly due to the AOC product share climbing to 71%—about a 10% quarterly rise—which not only lifted gross margin but also boosted overall growth. In addition, rising demand for AI data‑center (DC) solutions and RF component foundry work also helped drive AOC revenue higher.

An also noted that, with indium‑phosphide (InP) substrates and epitaxial wafer supplies stabilizing, shipment volumes rose sharply. The company raised AOC prices to reflect higher raw‑material costs, and reduced inventory write‑downs, both of which supported gross margin. However, RF wafer foundry revenue fell 7.6% quarter‑over‑quarter and optoelectronic wafer foundry revenue dropped 37% quarter‑over‑quarter, prompting the company to adjust its order intake strategy and focus on shipments for key customers.

Looking ahead, analysts forecast Q4 revenue of US$30 million to US$34 million (approximately NT$952 million‑NT$1.079 billion), with the potential for double‑digit quarterly growth. Gross margin is expected to stay in a high range of 46%‑50%. Operating expenses will rise to US$7.6 million‑US$8.6 million as CW‑laser development costs are deferred and related amortization begins to be recognized starting in Q4.

An said that as AOC demand remains robust and the company’s investment in Zhiwei Lufu (a subsidiary) adds extra capacity, strong shipment volumes are likely to continue. Regarding substrate materials, Huan Yu‑KY expects indium‑phosphide substrate prices to keep climbing and supply to tighten, with significant impact from U.S.–China political factors. The firm is working with partners on a rapid‑shipment strategy; supply for 2027 has been locked in through long‑term contracts, while 2028 arrangements are still under negotiation.

With Marvell’s acquisition of major optical‑communications player Lumentum, Huan Yu‑KY is optimistic about the overall market outlook. Substrate material supply is secure through 2027, ensuring smooth shipments, and An is confident that both Q4 and 2027 operations will continue to grow.

Analysts maintain that Huan Yu‑KY’s market outlook for this year and next remains stable and growth‑oriented. For the 200G PD product line, because non‑China substrate suppliers carry higher capacity risk, the company will add a second substrate source, which is expected to enable a significant volume increase by Q2 2027. They are bullish that both Q4 and next year’s operations will keep rising.

items.title: 1條飄帶騙走百萬！政院急下架逾5千假帳號 揭應援小物圈套
items.title_en: A Ribbon Scam Swindles Millions! Executive Yuan Quickly Takes Down Over 5,000 Fake Accounts, Exposes Support Merchandise Trap
paras: 距離投票倒數25天，選情逐漸升溫，卻有歹徒利用民眾挺候選人的熱情發動詐騙。民眾在社群平台上索取1件應援飄帶，慘遭詐騙近100萬元。行政院打擊詐欺指揮中心特別呼籲，民眾在熱情應援時務必提高警覺，只要貼文出現+ LINE、私訊、賣貨便、全家好賣、實名認證失敗等關鍵字，都是典型的詐騙手段，切勿輕易落入歹徒的話術圈套。
行政院打詐中心與刑事局詐防中心自10月起加強執行候選人應援小物詐騙貼文蒐報作業，截至11月2日已封鎖下架5071個詐騙帳號及貼文，近期每日可封鎖下架近500個詐騙帳號。被詐騙集團冒用的候選人遍佈台北、桃園、新竹、台中、高雄等地。單是10月1日至11月1日，警察機關即受理相關詐欺報案70件，受害金額高達1500萬元以上。
打詐中心指出，目前發現被冒用的應援小物包括御守、安全帽、吊飾、茄芷袋、徽章、髮夾、圍巾、陽傘、風車、帆布袋、護腕、冰袖等30多種。詐騙手法與傳統演唱會應援詐騙如出一轍，歹徒宣稱免費提供小物，吸引民眾私訊或加LINE，再以支付運費為由誘騙至假賣貨便或假全家好賣網頁，最終以實名認證失敗或金流認證失敗等藉口拐騙財物。
行政院打詐中心提醒，民眾若欲領取應援小物，應前往競選總部等實體地點，或透過候選人官方網站與官方帳號查詢，切勿輕信來路不明的網路貼文。若貼文者帳號成立未滿3個月或顯示海外地區，極可能為詐騙帳號，民眾應立即向平台檢舉，共同築起防詐防線。
paras_en: With only 25 days left before the vote, the campaign is heating up, but criminals are exploiting the public’s enthusiasm for candidates to launch scams. People on social media requested a single support ribbon and ended up losing nearly NT$1 million to fraud. The Executive Yuan’s anti‑fraud command urges citizens to stay vigilant when showing support; any post that mentions “+ LINE”, private messages, “sell‑goods‑link”, “FamilyMart good‑sale”, or “real‑name verification failed” are classic scam cues and should not be taken at face value.

Since October, the Executive Yuan’s anti‑fraud center and the Criminal Investigation Bureau’s fraud‑prevention unit have stepped up monitoring of candidate‑support merchandise scam posts. By November 2 they had blocked and removed 5,071 fraudulent accounts and posts, and in recent days they are taking down about 500 fake accounts daily. The fraudulent groups are impersonating candidates across Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Kaohsiung and other regions. From October 1 to November 1, police received 70 related fraud reports, with total losses exceeding NT$15 million.

The anti‑fraud center notes that more than 30 types of support items have been misused, including amulets, safety helmets, pendants, herbal bags, badges, hair clips, scarves, sun umbrellas, wind‑spinners, canvas bags, wrist guards, and ice sleeves. The scam method mirrors traditional concert‑support scams: perpetrators claim the items are free, lure victims to private‑message or add them on LINE, then request payment for shipping and direct them to fake e‑commerce pages or counterfeit “FamilyMart good‑sale” sites. Finally they cite “real‑name verification failed” or “payment verification failed” as excuses to steal the money.

The Executive Yuan’s anti‑fraud center advises anyone wishing to receive support merchandise to go to the campaign headquarters or other physical locations, or to verify through the candidate’s official website and official accounts. Do not trust obscure online posts. Accounts that are less than three months old or show an overseas location are highly likely to be fraudulent; users should report them to the platform immediately to help build a stronger anti‑fraud front.

paras_en: On November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Continuing strong demand for AI servers is boosting shipments, and Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) has raised its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast to $72 billion‑$82 billion (approximately NT$2.3587 trillion‑$2.6863 trillion), up from the prior $65 billion‑$72 billion (about NT$2.1294 trillion‑$2.3587 trillion). items.title: AMD資料中心營收近倍增 AI機櫃第四季擴大量產
items.title_en: AMD Data Center Revenue Nearly Doubles, AI Cabinet to Scale Up Mass Production in Q4
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 超微AMD(AMD-US)公布，第三季資料中心營收年增97%，帶動整體營收成長45%；公司預估第四季營收約170億美元（約新台幣5,569億元）、上下浮動3%，高於市場預期。隨著AI運算需求由模型訓練延伸至實際應用，GPU與伺服器CPU同步受惠，成為推升業績的主要動力。
第三季營收達133.8億美元（約新台幣4,383億元），其中資料中心營收創下85.5億美元（約新台幣2,801億元）新高，高於市場預估的82億美元（約新台幣2,686億元）。調整後每股盈餘為2.09美元，也優於市場預期的1.95美元。
AMD正將產品布局從單顆晶片擴展至整座AI機櫃。旗艦Helios機櫃結合MI455X加速器與新一代Venice伺服器處理器，目前已投入生產，預定第四季擴大量產，初期系統正在Meta(META-US)進行測試。這使AMD與輝達(NVDA-US)的競爭進一步延伸至整套資料中心運算系統。
依LSEG彙整，市場原估AMD第四季營收162.3億美元（約新台幣5,317億元）；公司財測中值較此高約4.7%。不過，第四季調整後毛利率預估約55%，低於第三季的56%。AI處理器所需的高頻寬記憶體仍供應吃緊，記憶體廠正加快擴產。
相較資料中心的強勁成長，涵蓋個人電腦晶片與遊戲機處理器的客戶端及遊戲業務，第三季營收年減8%至37.2億美元（約新台幣1,219億元），低於市場預期。兩大業務走勢分化，資料中心已成為AMD此輪成長的核心。

paras_en: November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) – AMD (AMD-US) announced that third‑quarter data‑center revenue grew 97% year over year, driving overall revenue up 45%; the company forecasts fourth‑quarter revenue of about $17 billion (approximately NT$5,569 billion), plus or minus 3%, above market expectations. As AI computing demand expands from model training to real‑world applications, both GPUs and server CPUs are benefiting, becoming the main drivers of the performance boost.

Third‑quarter revenue reached $13.38 billion (about NT$4,383 billion), with data‑center revenue hitting a new high of $8.55 billion (about NT$2,801 billion), surpassing the market estimate of $8.2 billion (about NT$2,686 billion). Adjusted earnings per share were $2.09, also beating the market forecast of $1.95.

AMD is expanding its product strategy from single chips to full AI cabinets. Its flagship Helios cabinet, which combines the MI455X accelerator with the next‑generation Venice server processor, is already in production and slated for large‑scale manufacturing in the fourth quarter, with early systems being tested at Meta (META-US). This pushes AMD’s competition with Nvidia (NVDA-US) further into complete data‑center computing systems.

According to LSEG data, the market originally estimated AMD’s fourth‑quarter revenue at $16.23 billion (about NT$5,317 billion); the company’s internal median forecast is roughly 4.7% higher than that. However, the adjusted gross margin for the fourth quarter is projected at about 55%, down from 56% in the third quarter. High‑bandwidth memory needed for AI processors remains in tight supply, prompting memory manufacturers to accelerate capacity expansion.

In contrast to the strong growth in the data‑center segment, AMD’s client and gaming businesses—covering PC chips and console processors—saw third‑quarter revenue decline 8% year over year to $3.72 billion (about NT$1,219 billion), missing market expectations. The two major segments are diverging, with the data‑center now becoming the core of AMD’s current growth cycle.

AI會引爆下一場金融海嘯嗎？前紐約聯準銀行總裁點出關鍵差別

items.title: 美光12月迎回購解禁！《巴隆》：2027財年潛在規模上看千億美元
items.title_en: Micron's December Share‑Buyback Lockup Ends; Barron's: FY2027 Potential Scale Could Reach $100 Billion
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，美光 (MU-US) 股票回購限制將於 12 月 9 日屆滿，可望為近期承壓的股價帶來支撐。若獲利與自由現金流符合預期，在截至 2027 年 8 月底的 2027 會計年度，公司潛在回購規模可能達到 1,000 億美元，相當於報導當時市值約一成。
這項潛在利多浮現之際，市場正重新評估記憶體漲價循環能延續多久。
日本 NAND 大廠鎧俠週一 (2 日) 公布審慎展望，拖累美光週一暴跌近 6%，週二隨著大盤回暖，收高2.58% 至每股 855.10 美元，今年迄今漲幅高達171.10%。
美光先前獲得約 60 億美元的美國晶片法案補助，用於支持包括紐約州在內的新記憶體廠建設，但補助條件嚴格限制股票回購，主要僅允許公司買回股票，以抵銷員工股權獎酬造成的股本稀釋。
因此，在截至 2026 年 8 月底的 2026 會計年度，美光僅回購約 6.5 億美元股票。
自今年 12 月 9 日起，美光接下來三年可執行的回購規模，將可大致與自由現金流相當，為擴大股東回饋打開空間。
公司已於 10 月 8 日將股票回購授權增加 330 億美元，使總額提高至 352 億美元，並表示長期目標是將百分之百的超額現金回饋股東。
不過，超額現金仍須考量營運、資金保留與其他用途，不能直接等同於全部自由現金流。
美光擴大回購的底氣，來自記憶體需求與價格上升帶動的獲利成長。
截至今年 8 月底的第四季，調整後每股盈餘達 33.42 美元，約為去年同期的十倍。公司在 9 月 30 日公布財報時，預估截至 11 月的當季每股盈餘約為 38 美元。
市場預估，美光 2027 會計年度自由現金流可望達到 1,400 億美元，高於上一年度的 590 億美元。自由現金流已扣除資本支出，若預測實現，意味公司在投資製程與產能後，仍可能保有可觀資金。
花旗分析師 Atif Malik 指出，美光 2027 會計年度資本支出將明顯增加，花旗估計約為 550 億美元，主要用於製程升級與產能擴張。
不過，在有利的產業環境下，公司仍預期產生大量自由現金流，並可在 12 月回購限制解除後，提高股東回饋。
瑞銀分析師 Tim Arcuri 則認為，美光的投資焦點已轉向記憶體景氣的延續時間、AI 推論對記憶體價值的提升，以及資本回饋能力。
Arcuri 預估，美光在 2027、2028 與 2029 曆年的自由現金流，可能分別達到約 1,550 億、2,250 億與 2,050 億美元。
他推算，公司未來兩年可能買回相當於約三成股本的股票，至 2029 年累計甚至可能接近一半。
不過，這項推估仍取決於現金流能否實現、回購授權及執行決策，以及實際買回時的股價。
美光資產負債表也明顯改善。
截至今年 8 月底，公司持有約 730 億美元現金及約當現金，債務約 50 億美元，淨現金約 680 億美元，相當於報導當時市值約 7%。
依報導採用的股價計算，美光過去 12 個月每股盈餘約為 75 美元，本益比約 11 倍。若以 2027 會計年度預估每股盈餘約 175 美元估算，預估本益比約為 5 倍。
然而，這項低估值建立在獲利維持高檔的預期上，市場關注的仍是記憶體價格與需求能否延續強勢。
12 月回購限制解除後，美光有機會透過擴大庫藏股支撐股價，但實際規模與持續性仍取決於營運表現。若記憶體價格意外下滑，現金流與回購能力也可能隨之減弱。
paras_en: Barron's reports that Micron (MU‑US) share‑buyback restrictions will expire on December 9, which could support the recently pressured stock. If earnings and free cash flow meet expectations, the company’s potential buyback size for the fiscal year ending August 2027 could reach $100 billion, roughly 10% of its market value at the time of reporting.
This potential upside emerges as the market re‑evaluates how long the memory price‑increase cycle can last.

Japanese NAND giant Kioxia announced a cautious outlook on Monday (the 2nd), dragging Micron down nearly 6% on Monday; on Tuesday, as the broader market recovered, Micron closed up 2.58% at $855.10 per share, up 171.10% year‑to‑date.

Micron previously received about $6 billion in U.S. CHIPS Act subsidies to support new memory fab construction, including in New York State, but the subsidy strictly limits share repurchases, allowing the company to buy back stock only to offset equity dilution from employee stock awards.
Consequently, for the fiscal year ending August 2026, Micron repurchased only about $650 million of its own shares.
Starting December 9 this year, Micron will be able to execute buybacks over the next three years roughly in line with its free cash flow, opening room to increase shareholder returns.
The company raised its share‑repurchase authorization by $33 billion on October 8, bringing the total to $352 billion, and said its long‑term goal is to return 100% of excess cash to shareholders.
However, excess cash must still consider operating needs, capital reserves and other uses, and cannot be equated directly with all free cash flow.
Micron’s confidence to expand buybacks stems from profit growth driven by rising memory demand and prices.

Adjusted earnings per share for Q4, ending August this year, were $33.42, about ten times the same quarter last year. When Micron released its September 30 earnings, it forecasted Q3 EPS of roughly $38.

The market estimates Micron’s FY2027 free cash flow could reach $140 billion, up from $59 billion the prior year. Free cash flow is calculated after capital expenditures, so if realized, it implies substantial cash remaining after investing in processes and capacity.
Citi analyst Atif Malik notes Micron’s FY2027 capital spending will rise sharply, estimating about $55 billion, mainly for process upgrades and capacity expansion.
Nevertheless, in a favorable industry backdrop, the company still expects to generate large free cash flow and can boost shareholder returns once the December buyback lockup lifts.
UBS analyst Tim Arcuri believes Micron’s investment focus has shifted to the duration of the memory cycle, AI inference’s impact on memory value, and capital return capability.
Arcuri projects Micron’s free cash flow for calendar years 2027, 2028 and 2029 could be about $155 billion, $225 billion and $205 billion respectively.
He estimates the company may repurchase shares equal to roughly 30% of equity over the next two years, potentially approaching 50% cumulatively by 2029.
However, this estimate still depends on cash flow realization, buyback authorizations and execution decisions, and the stock price at the time of repurchase.
Micron’s balance sheet has also improved markedly.

As of the end of August, the company held roughly $73 billion in cash and cash equivalents, about $5 billion in debt, leaving net cash of about $68 billion, roughly 7% of its market value at the time of reporting.

Based on the stock price used in the report, Micron’s trailing twelve‑month EPS was about $75, giving a P/E of roughly 11×. Using the FY2027 EPS estimate of about $175 yields an implied P/E of around 5×.
Nonetheless, this low valuation rests on expectations of sustained high earnings; the market remains focused on whether memory prices and demand can stay strong.

After the December lockup lifts, Micron could use an expanded treasury‑stock program to support its share price, but the actual scale and durability will still depend on operating performance. If memory prices unexpectedly fall, cash flow and buyback capacity could weaken.

items.title: AI投資恐慌過頭？野村揭科技巨頭自由現金流轉負真相：資料中心獲利潛力仍強
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資持續擴大，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 與Google(GOOGL-US) 等科技巨頭雖然大舉投入資料中心建設，卻也因資本支出激增，面臨自由現金流（FCF）轉負的壓力，進而引發市場對AI投資獲利能力的疑慮。不過，野村證券認為，投資人可能混淆企業獲利與現金流的差異，將大型科技公司自由現金流轉負解讀為AI無法獲利，導致近期科技股賣壓過度，尤其半導體類股可能遭到錯殺。
根據野村證券11月2日報告，近期科技股遭遇賣壓，主要來自兩項市場疑慮：一是AI業務可能侵蝕科技巨頭既有的傳統業務，二是大規模資本支出使自由現金流轉為負值。
然而，野村認為，這兩項擔憂未必構成利空。大型科技公司無法削減AI投資，反而代表算力需求仍然強勁，對半導體產業而言並非壞事；至於自由現金流轉負，則是資本支出與投資收益認列時間不同所造成的結果，不能直接視為企業獲利能力惡化。
野村強調，自由現金流轉負並不會改變半導體需求，也不會動搖半導體公司的估值基礎。如果市場因科技巨頭現金流壓力而持續拋售相關股票，反而可能為長期投資人創造布局機會。

雲端業務獲利持續改善　自由現金流轉負不等於虧損

野村指出，AI資料中心投資具有高度獲利潛力，目前大型科技公司的自由現金流轉負，主要反映資本支出與收益入帳之間的時間差，類似典型的J曲線效應。
企業在興建資料中心時，資本支出會立即反映為現金流出，但相關資產的折舊與營收，則會在設備投入使用後的5至20年間陸續認列。因此，短期現金流可能承受壓力，並不代表相關投資無法創造獲利。
第三季財報也顯示，主要雲端業者的營運表現仍相當強勁。
亞馬遜AWS第三季營收達460億美元，年增39%，創2021年以來最快增速，營業利益率則從去年同期的34.6%升至38.7%。
微軟Azure在2027會計年度第一季營收年增48%；Google Cloud第三季營收達307億美元，年增103%，營業利益率也從去年同期的23.7%大幅升至36.2%。
三大雲端服務商第三季雲端業務營收合計約1,100億美元，年增約56%。
野村認為，這些數據顯示，大型科技公司的營運收入持續成長，雲端業務獲利能力也在資本支出增加之際同步改善，與市場將自由現金流轉負解讀為企業不賺錢的說法並不相符。

三大因素推動AI投資　科技巨頭難以踩煞車

野村進一步指出，大型科技公司難以放緩AI基礎建設投資，背後有三項結構性因素。
首先，AI推論所需算力持續增加。推理模型與AI代理每次回應所消耗的運算資源，遠高於模型訓練階段，訓練完成後的強化學習同樣需要大量算力。若基礎設施不足，將直接限制AI模型的商業化規模。
其次，AI服務的營收成長瓶頸在於運算容量，而非市場需求不足。截至第三季末，Google Cloud未履行訂單金額達5,608億美元，AWS約4,960億美元，微軟商業剩餘履約義務（RPO）則達6,770億美元，年增73%。
微軟也透露，第三季實際資本支出低於原先規劃的500億美元，原因是第三方產能延遲，而非客戶需求疲弱。這也反映目前AI基礎建設的主要限制仍在供給端。
第三，企業客戶與AI平台之間的黏著度持續提高。當企業將工作流程、資料及AI代理深度整合至特定模型後，轉換平台的成本也會大幅增加。
野村認為，未來三年的算力建設將大致決定市場競爭格局，科技巨頭若此時放慢投資，真正付出的代價可能不是短期現金流壓力，而是失去長期市場地位。

合資、租賃與預售現金流　科技巨頭有多種融資選擇

針對自由現金流轉負的問題，野村整理出大型科技公司可能採取的四種策略，認為最可能的發展方向是維持目前投資速度，同時透過外部融資及資產結構調整緩解現金流壓力，而非直接凍結資本支出。
第一種方式是維持甚至加速投資。短期內自由現金流可能進一步惡化，但隨著資料中心陸續完工並投入營運，投資增速放緩後，相關設施將開始創造現金流，帶動自由現金流改善。因此，股價若因此下跌，將是長期投資人的機會。
第二種方式是凍結資本支出。雖然能立即改善現金流，但也可能導致未來營收大幅萎縮，削弱市場競爭力，並對半導體需求造成負面影響。野村認為，這種情境發生的機率極低。
第三種方式是透過合資企業與營運租賃分攤建設成本，由合作夥伴出資興建基礎設施，科技公司再透過租賃方式使用，將部分資本支出轉化為未來租金支出。
Meta(META-US) 在Hyperion資料中心專案中已採取類似模式，由Meta持股20%、Blue Owl管理的基金持股80%，並成立規模270億美元的特殊目的公司（SPV），發行取得標普全球評級A+的債券，再透過四年期、可續約的營運租賃協議使用相關設施。
第四種方式則是將未來現金流部分變現，將企業客戶已簽約的未來收入出售給退休基金、保險公司等長期投資人，提前取得資金，同時保留設備營運及客戶關係。
野村以甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的融資安排為例，指出該公司結合租賃、特殊目的公司、客戶預付款及客戶自行採購硬體等方式，維持原有投資計畫。
Oracle第三季已收到114億美元客戶預付款，顯示科技巨頭可以透過融資工具處理現金流壓力，而非被迫削減投資。

野村：短期算力供過於求風險有限　半導體仍有支撐

至於市場擔心AI資料中心大量興建，未來可能出現算力供過於求，導致每吉瓦（GW）算力創造的營收低於預期，野村認為，短期內發生的機率仍然偏低。
即使部分算力供給超過需求，大型科技公司仍可透過長期供應合約鎖定價格、將閒置算力轉用於模型訓練，以及適度調整資本支出等方式因應，對整體半導體需求的衝擊有限。
即使出現嚴重供過於求的極端情境，野村估計，記憶體晶片廠商約有50%至70%的出貨量已透過長期協議鎖定，且享有最低利潤率保障，相關業務的營業利益率估計仍可維持在60%以上，具備一定抗風險能力。
目前市場數據也尚未顯示明顯供過於求。第三季主要雲端業者營收成長全面加速，微軟資本支出低於原先計畫，更是受到第三方產能不足影響，而非需求減弱。
野村建議投資人持續追蹤雲端業務成長速度、GPU租賃價格及未履行訂單金額的變化，作為判斷AI基礎建設需求是否出現轉折的重要指標。

items.title: 美光股價自三個月低點回神 華爾街看好還有90%上漲空間
items.title_en: Micron stock rebounds from three‑month low, Wall Street sees 90% upside
paras: 美光(MU-US)股價周二(3日)從三個月低點反彈2.6%，止住連三日頹勢。這與分析師看法天差地遠，目前華爾街分析師的平均目標價代表仍有90%的上漲空間。
美光周二終場上漲2.6%至每股855.10美元，該股截至周一已經連三個交易日都下跌至少5%，周一最終收在三個月來最低水準。。
這波跌勢可能令華爾街許多分析師感到困惑，追蹤美光的分析師平均目標價為1,631美元，代表還有約90%上漲空間。
D.A. Davidson分析師Gil Luria可能是華爾街最看好美光的一位，他給出的目標價高達3,000美元，意味著股價還有約250%的上漲空間。他認為市場究竟忽略了什麼？
Luria上個月在一份研究報告中說：「我們相信，隨著投資人逐漸認識到美光的技術領先地位，以及由此形成的寬廣競爭護城河，他們將更願意給予美光符合整體市場水準的本益比。」
美光自12月9日起將可大舉實施庫藏股計畫，這項措施可能為股價帶來亟需的提振。但在這之前，市場唯一關注的依然是對人工智慧(AI)的疑慮。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) stock on Tuesday (the 3rd) rebounded 2.6% from a three‑month low, halting a three‑day decline. This is far from analysts’ views; the average Wall Street target price still implies about 90% upside.
Micron closed up 2.6% on Tuesday at $855.10 per share. The stock had fallen at least 5% for three consecutive trading days through Monday, which ended at its lowest level in three months.
This decline may have puzzled many Wall Street analysts; the average target price among those covering Micron is $1,631, indicating roughly 90% upside.
D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria may be the most bullish on Micron on Wall Street, assigning a target price of $3,000, implying about 250% upside. He wonders what the market is overlooking.

Luria said in a research note last month: “We believe that as investors increasingly recognize Micron’s technology leadership and the broad competitive moat it creates, they will be willing to grant Micron a price‑to‑earnings multiple in line with the broader market.”

Micron will be able to launch a large‑scale share‑repurchase program starting December 9, which could provide a needed boost to the stock. Until then, the market’s sole focus remains concerns about artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: 蘋果跌近2% 輝達重登全球市值王！AI投資疑慮尚未完全散去
items.title_en: Apple Slides Nearly 2% as Nvidia Reclaims Global Market‑Cap Crown; AI Investment Concerns Still Linger
paras: 《巴隆週刊》週二 (3 日) 報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 股價反彈，超越蘋果 (AAPL-US)，重新登上全球市值最高企業寶座。這場龍頭換位，反映市場對人工智慧 (AI) 投資的疑慮暫時緩和，也凸顯蘋果最新營收展望未能支撐其偏高估值。
輝達週二股價升幅超2%，報每股 206.69 美元，市值約 4.98 兆美元；蘋果則下跌約 2%，報每股 331.90 美元，市值約 4.84 兆美元。
上週五在 AI 類股重挫之際，蘋果甫取代輝達成為全球市值龍頭，如今排名迅速逆轉。
輝達被視為 AI 基礎建設熱潮的主要受惠者，相較之下，蘋果對這波 AI 投資循環的直接曝險較低，因此兩家公司近期的消長，也成為觀察市場風險偏好的窗口。
輝達週二上漲並沒有明確的單一催化因素，但市場對科技巨頭龐大 AI 支出的擔憂，可能暫時有所緩解。投資人等待美國期中選舉結果之際，費城半導體指數勁揚 2.63%，那斯達克指數上漲 0.83%，標普 500 指數終結連三日跌勢。
另一項受到關注的消息，是黃仁勳對 Marvell (MRVL-US) 與 Lumentum (LITE-US) 合併案的態度。
《彭博》引述知情人士報導，兩家公司週一宣布交易前，Marvell 執行長墨菲 (Matthew Murphy) 與 Lumentum 執行長赫爾斯頓 (Michael Hurlston) 曾與黃仁勳通話，並獲得他的支持。
Marvell 與 Lumentum 分別布局資料中心連網晶片及光通訊元件。隨著 AI 資料中心規模擴大，高速資料傳輸已成為支撐運算效能的重要環節，市場也擔心供應能力跟不上建置需求。
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) 週一股價暴跌約 13%，週二小幅回穩 0.33%。Lumentum (LITE-US)則續跌超 0.6%。
分析指出，Marvell 與 Lumentum  供應商整合資源，可能有利於輝達的供應鏈布局。
輝達今年稍早已分別向 Marvell 與 Lumentum 投資 20 億美元，取得可轉換特別股，顯示其對兩家公司技術與產能的重視。
不過，黃仁勳支持合併的消息，仍不足以證明市場對 AI 投資回報的疑慮已經消退。
這次市值排名迅速翻轉，更直接的原因可能在於蘋果自身。蘋果最新一季財報表現穩健，但營收展望未能充分化解投資人對高估值的擔憂，股價因此承壓。
根據 FactSet 調查，蘋果週二的預估本益比約為 36 倍，較過去五年平均高出約 5 倍。
這代表投資人已為其未來獲利支付較高價格，也使市場對科技巨頭後續成長展望提出更高要求；即使當季業績穩健，只要財測未能滿足期待，股價仍可能面臨修正壓力。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Tuesday the 3rd that Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares rebounded, overtaking Apple (AAPL-US) to retake the title of world’s most valuable company. This leadership swap reflects a temporary easing of market worries over AI investments and highlights that Apple’s latest revenue outlook failed to justify its lofty valuation.
Nvidia rose over 2% on Tuesday, trading at $206.69 per share and a market cap of about $4.98 trillion; Apple fell roughly 2% to $331.90 per share, with a market cap near $4.84 trillion.
Last Friday, amid a sharp drop in AI‑related stocks, Apple had just displaced Nvidia as the global market‑cap leader, a ranking that has now flipped back quickly.

Nvidia is seen as a primary beneficiary of the AI infrastructure boom, whereas Apple’s direct exposure to this AI investment cycle is lower, making the recent fortunes of the two firms a barometer of market risk appetite.

Nvidia’s Tuesday gain had no single clear catalyst, but concerns over massive AI spending by tech giants may have eased temporarily. While investors await the U.S. mid‑term election results, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 2.63%, the Nasdaq rose 0.83%, and the S&P 500 ended a three‑day losing streak.
Another story drawing attention is Jensen Huang’s stance on the Marvell (MRVL-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) merger.
Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that before the deal was announced on Monday, Marvell CEO Matthew Murphy and Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston spoke with Jensen Huang and received his backing.

Marvell and Lumentum each focus on data‑center networking chips and photonic components. As AI data‑center scale expands, high‑speed data transfer has become a critical piece of computing performance, and the market worries supply may not keep pace with demand.
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) plunged about 13% on Monday and steadied modestly by 0.33% on Tuesday, while Lumentum (LITE-US) continued to fall more than 0.6%.
Analysts note that the integration of Marvell and Lumentum’s supply capabilities could benefit Nvidia’s supply‑chain positioning.
Earlier this year Nvidia invested $2 billion each in Marvell and Lumentum, acquiring convertible preferred shares, underscoring its interest in their technology and capacity.
However, Huang’s support for the merger alone does not prove that market doubts over AI investment returns have vanished.

The rapid reversal in market‑cap rankings is likely driven more directly by Apple itself. Apple’s latest quarterly earnings were solid, but its revenue outlook failed to fully allay investor concerns over its high valuation, keeping the stock under pressure.
FactSet data shows Apple’s estimated price‑to‑earnings ratio on Tuesday was about 36×, roughly five multiples above its five‑year average.

This indicates investors are paying a premium for Apple’s future profits, raising expectations for the tech giant’s growth; even with steady quarterly results, a disappointing outlook could still trigger stock‑price corrections.

items.title: AI股不再是華爾街寵兒？最受追捧股票跑輸冷門股、創近30年極端紀錄
items.title_en: AI Stocks Are No Longer Wall Street Darlings? Most Favored Shares Lag Behind Obscure Stocks, Setting Near‑30‑Year Extreme Record
paras: 美股市場近期出現罕見現象，過去深受華爾街分析師追捧的人工智慧（AI）概念股，近幾個月遭遇猛烈賣壓，股價表現反而落後於原本最不受分析師青睞的個股。市場資金偏好出現反轉，也讓華爾街開始關注，這是否意味著企業獲利前景或整體經濟環境正醞釀重大轉變。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，Piper Sandler首席投資策略師Kantrowitz的分析指出，過去一年，華爾街評等最高的股票相較於評等最低的股票，表現落後的程度已躋身1990年代中期以來最極端的三次紀錄之一。
這項分析將標普11大產業中，分析師買進評等占比最高與最低的個股進行比較，藉此衡量市場最受追捧與最不被看好的股票之間的相對表現。
Kantrowitz及其團隊指出，華爾街最看好的股票出現如此大幅度的落後表現並不常見，過去類似情況通常發生在企業獲利前景或整體經濟環境開始轉變之際。
回顧過去三次類似情況，2000年10月，聯準會（Fed）寬鬆政策帶動夏季股市反彈後，隨著投資人逐漸意識到網路泡沫正在破裂，原本受到追捧的科技股開始失去動能。
2009年2月，全球經濟在金融海嘯後逐漸觸底，先前遭到重挫、分析師評等偏低的景氣循環股大幅反彈，漲勢超越市場原本看好的個股。
到了2020年10月，隨著市場預期新冠肺炎（COVID-19）疫苗即將獲准上市，投資人開始押注經濟重新開放，帶動相關股票走強。
從目前華爾街分析師最看好的10檔股票來看，資訊科技與通訊服務類股占據多數席次。
其中，雲端網路設備商Arista網路(ANET-US) 及電信與衛星通訊服務供應商EchoStar ECHO-US) 是分析師評等最高的兩檔股票，給予這兩家公司買進評等的分析師比例均超過87%。
相較之下，根據Piper Sandler的資料，保德信金融(PRU-US) 與普徠仕集團(TROW-US) 則名列分析師最不看好的股票之首，目前沒有任何分析師給予這兩家公司買進評等。
paras_en: The U.S. equity market has recently shown a rare phenomenon: AI‑related stocks, which have long been championed by Wall Street analysts, have faced heavy selling pressure over the past few months, and their price performance has fallen behind that of the stocks that analysts originally disliked the most. This reversal in capital preference has prompted Wall Street to wonder whether it signals a major shift in corporate earnings outlook or the broader economic environment.

According to MarketWatch, Piper Sandler chief investment strategist Kantrowitz noted that over the past year the highest‑rated stocks by Wall Street analysts have underperformed the lowest‑rated stocks to a degree that ranks among the three most extreme gaps since the mid‑1990s.

The analysis compared, across S&P’s eleven sectors, the stocks with the highest and lowest analyst buy‑rating percentages, using this to gauge the relative performance of the market’s most‑watched versus least‑favored shares.

Kantrowitz and his team said that such a pronounced lag among Wall Street’s top‑rated stocks is uncommon; historically, similar gaps have tended to appear when corporate profit prospects or the overall economic backdrop begin to change.

Looking back at the three prior episodes, in October 2000 the Federal Reserve’s accommodative policy sparked a summer market rally, but as investors gradually realized the internet bubble was bursting, the once‑celebrated tech stocks lost momentum.

In February 2009, as the global economy bottomed out after the financial crisis, cyclical stocks that had been heavily hit and received low analyst ratings rebounded sharply, outpacing the stocks that had been the market’s favorites.
By October 2020, expectations that a COVID‑19 vaccine would soon be approved led investors to bet on an economic reopening, lifting the related stocks.
Among the ten stocks currently rated most favorably by Wall Street analysts, information‑technology and communication‑services companies dominate the list.

The top‑rated stocks are cloud‑network equipment maker Arista Networks (ANET‑US) and telecom and satellite‑service provider EchoStar (ECHO‑US), each receiving buy ratings from more than 87% of analysts covering them.
In contrast, Piper Sandler data show that Prudential Financial (PRU‑US) and T. Rowe Price Group (TROW‑US) rank as the least‑favored stocks, with no analyst assigning a buy rating to either company.

items.title: AI伺服器需求強勁 美超微上修全年營收展望、毛利率優於初估
items.title_en: Strong AI Server Demand Leads Super Micro to Raise Full-Year Revenue Outlook, Gross Margin Beats Initial Estimate
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器需求持續推升出貨，美超微Super Micro Computer(SMCI-US)將2027會計年度營收預測上調至720億至820億美元（約新台幣2兆3,587億至2兆6,863億元），高於原先的650億至720億美元（約新台幣2兆1,294億至2兆3,587億元）。依預測中值估算，全年營收展望提高約12.4%。
截至9月30日的第一季，美超微營收達199.5億美元（約新台幣6,536億元），調整後每股盈餘1.81美元，高於市場預估的1.23美元。毛利率為12.7%，也超過公司10月20日公布的12%至12.5%初估區間。
美超微在10月的初步營運更新中，已因AI平台需求增加而調高第一季營收估計，並將毛利率預估由10.4%至10.8%提高至12%至12.5%，當時指出，改善主要來自客戶與產品組合。
公司預估第二季營收為195億至215億美元（約新台幣6,388億至7,043億元），高於市場預期的171.4億美元（約新台幣5,615億元）。美超微供應搭載輝達晶片的AI伺服器，雲端服務商與科技公司持續擴充資料中心，支撐相關系統需求；新一季財測也意味營收可望維持接近第一季的高檔水準。

paras_en: On November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Continuing strong demand for AI servers is boosting shipments, and Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) has raised its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast to $72 billion‑$82 billion (approximately NT$2.3587 trillion‑$2.6863 trillion), up from the prior $65 billion‑$72 billion (about NT$2.1294 trillion‑$2.3587 trillion). The company now expects Q2 revenue of $19.5 billion‑$21.5 billion (approximately NT$638.8 billion‑$704.3 billion), above the market consensus of $17.14 billion (about NT$561.5 billion). Super Micro supplies AI servers equipped with NVIDIA chips, and cloud providers and tech firms are continuously expanding data centers, supporting related system demand; the new quarterly outlook also suggests revenue can stay near the high level seen in Q1.

items.title: AMD資料中心營收近倍增 AI機櫃第四季擴大量產
items.title_en: AMD Data Center Revenue Nearly Doubles, AI Cabinet to Scale Up Mass Production in Q4
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 超微AMD(AMD-US)公布，第三季資料中心營收年增97%，帶動整體營收成長45%；公司預估第四季營收約170億美元（約新台幣5,569億元）、上下浮動3%，高於市場預期。隨著AI運算需求由模型訓練延伸至實際應用，GPU與伺服器CPU同步受惠，成為推升業績的主要動力。
第三季營收達133.8億美元（約新台幣4,383億元），其中資料中心營收創下85.5億美元（約新台幣2,801億元）新高，高於市場預估的82億美元（約新台幣2,686億元）。調整後每股盈餘為2.09美元，也優於市場預期的1.95美元。
AMD正將產品布局從單顆晶片擴展至整座AI機櫃。旗艦Helios機櫃結合MI455X加速器與新一代Venice伺服器處理器，目前已投入生產，預定第四季擴大量產，初期系統正在Meta(META-US)進行測試。這使AMD與輝達(NVDA-US)的競爭進一步延伸至整套資料中心運算系統。
依LSEG彙整，市場原估AMD第四季營收162.3億美元（約新台幣5,317億元）；公司財測中值較此高約4.7%。不過，第四季調整後毛利率預估約55%，低於第三季的56%。AI處理器所需的高頻寬記憶體仍供應吃緊，記憶體廠正加快擴產。
相較資料中心的強勁成長，涵蓋個人電腦晶片與遊戲機處理器的客戶端及遊戲業務，第三季營收年減8%至37.2億美元（約新台幣1,219億元），低於市場預期。兩大業務走勢分化，資料中心已成為AMD此輪成長的核心。

paras_en: November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) – AMD (AMD-US) announced that third‑quarter data‑center revenue grew 97% year over year, driving overall revenue up 45%; the company forecasts fourth‑quarter revenue of about $17 billion (approximately NT$5,569 billion), plus or minus 3%, above market expectations. As AI computing demand expands from model training to real‑world applications, both GPUs and server CPUs are benefiting, becoming the main drivers of the performance boost.

Third‑quarter revenue reached $13.38 billion (about NT$4,383 billion), with data‑center revenue hitting a new high of $8.55 billion (about NT$2,801 billion), surpassing the market estimate of $8.2 billion (about NT$2,686 billion). Adjusted earnings per share were $2.09, also beating the market forecast of $1.95.

AMD is expanding its product strategy from single chips to full AI cabinets. Its flagship Helios cabinet, which combines the MI455X accelerator with the next‑generation Venice server processor, is already in production and slated for large‑scale manufacturing in the fourth quarter, with early systems being tested at Meta (META-US). This pushes AMD’s competition with Nvidia (NVDA-US) further into complete data‑center computing systems.

According to LSEG data, the market originally estimated AMD’s fourth‑quarter revenue at $16.23 billion (about NT$5,317 billion); the company’s internal median forecast is roughly 4.7% higher than that. However, the adjusted gross margin for the fourth quarter is projected at about 55%, down from 56% in the third quarter. High‑bandwidth memory needed for AI processors remains in tight supply, prompting memory manufacturers to accelerate capacity expansion.

In contrast to the strong growth in the data‑center segment, AMD’s client and gaming businesses—covering PC chips and console processors—saw third‑quarter revenue decline 8% year over year to $3.72 billion (about NT$1,219 billion), missing market expectations. The two major segments are diverging, with the data‑center now becoming the core of AMD’s current growth cycle.

AI會引爆下一場金融海嘯嗎？前紐約聯準銀行總裁點出關鍵差別
